# North Harbor Digital

> Websites, hosting, and managed social media for service businesses on the East Coast. Built and supported by real people who answer the phone — no chatbots, no tickets, no overseas call centers.

North Harbor Digital builds and maintains websites for plumbers, contractors, salons, and other local service businesses. Pricing is flat and transparent. Based in Levittown, New York.

## Contact
- Email: rightnow@rocketship.com
- Phone: 516.907.7001
- Location: Levittown, New York
- Service area: East Coast United States

## Services and pricing

- **Custom Website Design** — $799 one-time. Mobile-responsive, basic SEO, booking/contact form. https://northharbordigital.net/services.html
- **Professional Web Hosting** — $249/month. SSL, daily backups, uptime monitoring, email + phone support. https://northharbordigital.net/hosting.html
- **Social Media Management** — $199/month. Four posts per month across Facebook, Instagram, and Google Business; captions written in your voice; engagement monitoring during business hours; scale up to 8/12/16 posts. https://northharbordigital.net/social.html

## Who we serve

Plumbers, electricians, HVAC, general contractors, roofers, landscapers, hair and nail salons, auto detailers, and other owner-operated service businesses that need a professional online presence without managing it themselves.

## What makes us different

- Flat pricing. No surprise invoices.
- Real human support. Phone calls answered by a person, usually within an hour.
- Fully managed. We handle hosting, updates, plugins, and SSL — owners focus on their work.
- No long-term contracts on hosting or social.
